feeds.title: knit/lab
feeds.description: I design knitting patterns and started this blog to collect and share my inspirations and photos. Blog by Kieran Foley.

feeds.title: Knitting Tours Blog
feeds.description: KnittingTours.com has been creating amazing knitting tours for several years. All of our knitting tours include workshops with amazing knitting instructors. KnittingTours.com is part of the Irish Tourism Group, one of Ireland's leading inbound tour operators.

feeds.title: Carol Feller
feeds.description: Stolen Stitches hand knit designs are well-shaped, flattering to wear and enjoyable to knit. These are designs with a difference: not overly complex, but still giving a very unique end product. Here can find great knitting techniques by Carol Feller.

feeds.title: Knitting Squirrel Blog
feeds.description: I love sharing unique knitting projects, exploring colour & inspiring your creativity. Knitting Squirrel sells knitting wool & sock yarn in glorious colours & fibres. Blog by Nicolette Kernohan.

feeds.title: EvinOK
feeds.description: This blog shares my love of knitting, crafting, sewing, making things with my sons, and baking. Find interesting and daily tid bits from life.

feeds.title: The Donegal Shop
feeds.description: The Donegal Shop prides itself in being a 100% independently owned Irish shop as well as being a family run business since 1995. Ireland has a strong tradition of crafts, successfully handed down over hundreds of years with emphasis on natural fabrics. We aim, in as much as possible to have as many products as possible that are Made In Ireland.

feeds.title: Woollinn: Dublin's Festival of Yarn
feeds.description: Dublin's brand new indie yarn fest is coming in May 2018! A boutique yarn and supplies market, a range of diverse fibre and stitching classes, and a chance to meet a community of likeminded crafters in one brilliant weekend of YARN.

feeds.title: Dublin Knit Collective
feeds.description: Dublin's knitting scene and our Knitworking adventures.

feeds.title: Heather Finn Irish Knitwear Blog
feeds.description: Irish Knitwear with a focus on colour and pattern in fine wool and cashmere yarns. I have been experimenting with colour, pattern, crochet, hand knitting and felting with machine knitting, to create my brand of vibrant knitwear. Blog by Heather Finn.

feeds.title: Celtic Memory Yarns
feeds.description: Writer, historian and fibre fiend talks about life in Ireland, travel in odd places, dogs, cats, scenery, knitting, and that constant search for the unusual and undiscovered.

feeds.title: We Do Not Have A Knitting Problem
feeds.description: Carrie Sullivan Knitter, Designer blogging about yarn, college football, tea, cupcakes and my random everyday pursuit of happiness.

feeds.title: Make & Wear
feeds.description: At Make and Wear, an Irish enthusiast with a passion for sewing and knitting shares her journey in creating unique garments. With a background in Textiles, she explores the world of fabric and fibre, hand-knitting and venturing into machine knitting. Her creations reflect her love for craftsmanship and individuality.

feeds.title: This is Knit
feeds.description: An independent, family-owned yarn shop stocking quality yarns, both local & imported. Back then we were a mother-and-daughter team, with high hopes of discovering other natural-fibre-knitting enthusiasts 'out there' on the island of Ireland.

feeds.title: Aran Sweater Market Blog
feeds.description: The Aran Sweater, also known as a Fisherman Irish Sweater, the famous original since 1892; quality authentic Aran sweater & Irish sweaters from the Aran Islands, Ireland.
